==='''ConDFW, Dallas, TX - 17-21 February 2011'''===


'''''Report from Terez at Theoryland:'''''


So, Brandon went to [http://www.condfw.org/ this con] in Dallas, and some nice people from the tor.com re-read asked Brandon a few questions. For some reason the report is hidden on a secret Facebook page but they were kind enough to invite me. Thanks to James E. Jones for harassing Brandon.

<br />
'''Fiddler:''' How would you compare Murandy's forces to those of Tear?<br />'''Brandon:''' (Paraphrase) If Murandy had any significant forces, would they have needed to hire the Band?

<br />
'''Tektonica: '''Does Moridin know that Rand drew the True Power through their connection?<br />'''Brandon:''' (Paraphrase) It's always best to assume that Moridin knows a lot more than he's revealed.

<br />
There were also some RAFOs for other questions, but I'm not sure which. Nothing exciting, though (I looked through all their questions, but I dunno if he asked all of them). I'm going to footnote the Murandy quote with some pretty predictable arguments.

URL for report: http://www.theoryland.com/vbulletin/showthread.php?t=5300
